visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist with short brown hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a beige turtleneck, speaks directly to the camera in a professional clinic setting. A RODE lavalier microphone is clipped to her collar. Behind her, a shelf holds a picture frame and skincare products. (2) The scene cuts to extreme close-ups of human skin on the nose and cheek areas, revealing small, flesh-colored bumps or comedones under bright, even lighting. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear to emphasize her points. (3) The doctor points to her own face, specifically her chin and cheek, while graphics of flowers and a stylized sun emoji appear around her. She maintains an expressive facial expression with active mouth movements and raised eyebrows. (4) A sequence of product shots and infographics follows, showcasing tubes of Differin gel and other A-acid medications. Text labels for '1st Generation' through '4th Generation' A-acid appear in chronological order alongside product images against a clean background. (5) The final phase features an outro card with the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo, a LINE ID '@drx.derm', a phone number '02-8985-9060', and two address locations in Sanchong and Zhongshan districts, Taipei.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a high-arousal, energetic Mandarin Chinese tone, supported by a mid-tempo, upbeat synth-pop BGM with a clear electronic drum beat. A soft 'whoosh' SFX signals the first visual transition. (2) As the speaker describes skin textures, her voice fluctuates in pitch to emphasize key terms like '一颗一颗' (one by one). Periodic 'ding' and 'pop' SFX are synchronized with the appearance of on-screen text graphics. (3) During the medical explanation phase, the BGM remains consistent in volume but the speaker's articulation becomes more enunciated and authoritative. The spectral brightness is high, indicating professional studio mastering with high tonal clarity. (4) The final phase features the speaker's closing recommendation with a friendly, encouraging vocal valence, followed by a slight swell in the BGM volume as the voice ends and the outro card appears, concluding with a hard cut of both audio tracks.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Terminological Definition -> Technical Comparison -> Expert Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on how to identify 'closed comedones' (non-inflammatory acne) and provides a professional medical comparison of different generations of A-acid treatments. It ultimately promotes the clinic's expertise and recommends a starting point for first-time users.
